component.name: Unofficial Muse for Linux
component.summary: An independent Linux-native assistant desktop prototype

description.p: An independent native GTK4 companion prototype for the user's existing Muse personal agent, not affiliated with or supported by Meta.

Native shared chat/history and read-only scheduled-task/run lists use an explicitly selected external community adapter and the user's own session. This unsupported internal protocol can change; the external Python environment and protocol assets are not bundled.

Local folder browsing and text preview remain session-only and read-only. Account linkage is not Mac-style device registration or local-tool dispatch. Fresh browser sign-in, native Wayland, file writes, and desktop connectors require further validation or implementation.
